hypothesis_id.description: The ID of the hypothesis evaluated.

check_type.description: Type of verification check executed. 'evidence_grounding' is the non-discriminating fallback that confirms referenced evidence exists without testing the mechanism a hypothesis asserts.

check_code_or_query.description: The exact script, query, or invariant assertion used to verify.

execution_output.description: Raw execution stdout, test output, or query response.

verified_evidence_ids.description: List of evidence IDs verified during this check.

reasoning.description: Justification of why the check confirms, rejects, or leaves inconclusive the hypothesis.
